limitations: DumpGPU captures RDG-visible resources only; resources never referenced by an RDG pass, or resources flagged SkipTracking/memoryless, are absent and are listed as unsupported.
Shader-local intermediate registers and values inside shader invocations are not DumpGPU resources; shader source mapping is evidence, not a memory capture.
r.DumpGPU.RedumpInputs=0 keeps the producer version of in-place-modified resources; the version linkage is recorded in Passes.json rather than forcing per-read duplicates.

exposure.note: Not manual exposure. The unbound PostProcessVolume leaves AEM_HISTOGRAM active; min=max=4 locks the histogram-derived exposure to EV100 4.

portable_paths_note: Absolute host paths were replaced by portable public placeholders; measurements, hashes, sizes and resource records are unchanged.
